name: C2 - HTTP/S Application-Layer Beaconing (Custom)
blast_radius: Issues five periodic HTTP GET requests to the lab-local bfsisim simulator. No state is created on the host. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable.
telemetry: Periodic HTTP GET beacon pattern to lab-local simulator
detection: Periodic application-layer beacon detection (interval and regularity analysis)

name: C2 - Encrypted Channel over Loopback TLS (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates a short-lived self-signed certificate in CurrentUser\My and a loopback-only TLS listener on 127.0.0.1. Both are removed before the step returns and again by undo. The certificate is never installed in a trusted store.
detection: Encrypted channel detection on unexpected local listeners

name: C2 - Ingress Tool Transfer (Custom)
blast_radius: Downloads one response body from the lab-local simulator into a per-run directory under the temp folder. Removes only that file and its directory. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable.
telemetry: HTTP GET of a payload-shaped response from lab-local simulator
detection: Ingress tool transfer detection (download followed by file write)

name: C2 - Communication over Non-Standard Port (Custom)
blast_radius: Issues one GET request to the lab-local simulator on its configured non-standard port. No state is created. Fails loudly if the configured port is a well-known one. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable.
telemetry: HTTP GET to lab-local simulator on a non-standard port
